finding.title: Email input changes SQL syntax
finding.rationale: If an attacker controls email, the value ' OR '1'='1 produces a query that returns all users instead of the requested user. The function passes the concatenated SQL directly to the database.
finding.suggestion: Extend Db.query to accept bound parameters and bind email through a placeholder.
